几个人进入到屋子里，许紫烟看到族长和父亲的表情，心中已经知道此事是瞒不过去了，苦笑着将门轻轻的关上。许浩然神色激动地望着对面的许光，轻声的呼道：
“十一弟！”
“你真的是十一弟？”旁边的许浩博也激动地上前一把抓住许光的胳膊。
许光苦涩的一笑，带着自己的妻子向着许浩然和许浩博深施一礼道：
“大哥！”
许浩然上前一把抓住许光的手臂，激动地红了眼睛，颤声说道：
“浩光，真的是你！”
“浩光？难道父亲原来的名字叫许浩光？”许紫烟在心里暗自思量到。
“大哥，二哥，是我。”许浩光低着头，脸上充满了感叹，眼中有回忆也有迷茫。
许浩然，许浩博和许浩光三个人似乎有说不完的话，感不完的叹。许紫烟和母亲静静地坐在旁边，许氏的脸上挂着从小地方出来的人对于未知的畏惧，而许紫烟则是充满了好奇，她认真地听着父亲和两个伯父之间的对话，从他们的对话中熟悉着这个世界，和自己未来要生活的家族。
可是随着许浩然三人的聊天，屋子里的气氛逐渐凝重。许紫烟从他们话里听出来，如今的许家并不平静。在外有着萧家和吴家隐隐地联手打压，在内许浩然这个族长也没有完全掌控全族。许浩然这一辈总共有兄弟姐妹二十三人，十五男八女。除了嫁出去的五个女子之外，还有三个女子招了倒插门女婿。
而就是留在家族中的这十八个人却分成了两个势力，以族长许浩然为首，团结了九个兄弟和两个妹妹占着绝对的优势，但是以老九许浩量也拉拢了五个兄弟和一个姐姐，拥有着一股不可忽视的力量。而且那许浩量正是当初嘲讽许浩光领头人。
“浩光，你看你想在家族中担任什么职位，说出来，大哥也好为你安排。”屋子里短暂的沉寂之后，许浩然轻声地问道。
许浩光轻轻地摇了摇头，淡淡地说道：“大哥，你就不要为难你自己了，我如今不过仅仅是后天七层的实力，你如果让我在家族中任职，恐怕首先就过不去老九那一关。”
“可是烟儿……”
“烟儿是烟儿，我是我！”许浩光仍然是淡淡地摇了摇头，只是嘴角掠过了一丝苦笑。轻叹了一声道：“大哥，我不想让族中的人知道我回来了。”
“瞒不住的！”许浩然轻轻地摇了摇头：“刚才我和二弟在门口迎接你们的时候，我想老九他们一定在远处观望，就算刚才没有认出来，时间长了，等到你们见面的时候，也不可能认不出来。”
“可是烟儿现在年纪还小，又是刚回家族，修为又弱……”许浩光的目光中透露出担忧。
“那又怎么样？”许浩然的胸膛一挺，一股霸气凛然而生，沉声说道：“有我在，谁敢对烟儿如何？”说道这里，目光中又透露出歉意，语气有些无奈地对着许浩光说道：“只是……浩光，老九他们恐怕又要针对你……，而且如果老九知道了烟儿是你的女儿，而且在制符方面有着如此的潜力，恐怕会……”

听着父亲他们的话，许紫烟一直在沉思，自己想了好久，也一直想不出什么好的解决办法，唯一能够想到的就是“拖”字诀。只是心里又不知道是否可用，于是便轻声地把自己的主意说了出来。
听了许紫烟的话，屋子里一下子寂静无声，最终许浩然一拍大腿赞道：
“妙啊！我们只要把十一弟一家安排在二弟的园子里，然后告诉别人，就说烟儿不喜别人打扰，不让老九他们和浩光见面就可以了。但是……”
许浩然突然又沉思不语，旁边的许浩博也反应了过来，徐徐地说道：
“只是烟儿以后在符堂工作，总要见人，时间长了，如果老九他们说一定要拜见烟儿父母，恐怕烟儿也不好当面拒绝。毕竟老九他们在家族的地位在那，而烟儿只不过是一个客卿长老！”
“那……我就不去符堂，我只在二伯父的院子里制符就可以了。”许紫烟略微沉思了一下，轻声说道。
“这也不妥！”许浩然摇着头说道：“你躲在你二伯父的园子里，原本这也没有什么。大家都知道制符师的脾气很古怪，你不见他人也没有人会觉得奇怪。但是作为家族的客卿长老是有权利去浏览家族藏书楼三层以下的秘笈的。如果你不出你二伯的园子，如何去看藏书阁的秘笈？如果你不去看秘笈，又如何提高你的修为？但是你若是前往藏书楼，就必然会和老九他们相遇，老九他们是不会放过拉拢你的机会的，你是躲不开他们的。”

Several people entered the house. Xu Ziyan saw the expressions of the patriarch and his father. He already knew in his heart that the matter could not be hidden. He smiled bitterly and closed the door gently. Xu Haoran looked at Xu Guang across from him with excitement and shouted softly:
"Brother Eleven!"
"Are you really the eleventh brother?" Xu Haobo, who was next to him, also excitedly stepped forward and grabbed Xu Guang's arm.
Xu Guang smiled bitterly, and with his wife, he bowed deeply to Xu Haoran and Xu Haobo and said:
"Brother!"
Xu Haoran stepped forward and grabbed Xu Guang's arm, his eyes red with excitement, and said with a trembling voice:
"Haoguang, it's really you!"
"Haoguang? Could it be that my father's original name was Xu Haoguang?" Xu Ziyan thought secretly in his heart.
"Eldest brother, second brother, it's me." Xu Haoguang lowered his head, his face full of sighs, and there were memories and confusion in his eyes.
Xu Haoran, Xu Haobo and Xu Haoguang seemed to have endless things to say and sighs to express. Xu Ziyan and her mother sat quietly next to her. Xu Ziyan's face was filled with the fear of the unknown that people who came from a small place had, while Xu Ziyan was full of curiosity. She listened carefully to the conversation between her father and her two uncles, and became familiar with the world and the family she would live in in the future.
But as Xu Haoran and the three chatted, the atmosphere in the room gradually became solemn. Xu Ziyan heard from their words that the Xu family is not peaceful now. Outside, the Xiao family and the Wu family were working together to suppress the family, but inside, Xu Haoran, the clan leader, did not fully control the entire clan. Xu Haoran's generation has a total of twenty-three brothers and sisters, fifteen boys and eight girls. In addition to the five women who got married, three other women hired intrusive sons-in-law.
The eighteen people who remained in the family were divided into two factions. Headed by the clan leader Xu Haoran, who united nine brothers and two sisters, they had an absolute advantage. However, the ninth elder, Xu Haoliang, also united five brothers and one sister, and had a force that could not be ignored. And that Xu Haoliang was the leader who mocked Xu Haoguang in the first place.
"Haoguang, tell me what position you want to hold in the family, and my eldest brother can arrange it for you." After a brief silence in the room, Xu Haoran asked softly.
Xu Haoguang shook his head gently and said calmly: "Brother, please don't embarrass yourself. I am only the seventh level of acquired strength now. If you let me serve in the family, I'm afraid I won't be able to pass Lao Jiu's test first."
"But Yan'er..."
"Yan'er is Yan'er, I am me!" Xu Haoguang still shook his head lightly, but there was a wry smile at the corner of his mouth. He sighed softly and said: "Brother, I don't want people in the clan to know that I'm back."
"I can't hide it!" Xu Haoran shook his head gently: "When my second brother and I greeted you at the door just now, I thought Lao Jiu and the others must have been watching from a distance. Even if they didn't recognize him just now, as time goes by, it's impossible not to recognize him when you meet."
"But Yan'er is still young now, has just returned to the family, and is weak in cultivation..." Xu Haoguang's eyes revealed worry.
"So what?" Xu Haoran's chest puffed up, and he said in a deep voice, "With me here, who dares to do anything to Yan'er?" After saying this, his eyes showed apology again, and he said to Xu Haoguang helplessly: "It's just... Haoguang, Lao Jiu and the others may be targeting you again..., and if Lao Jiu knows that Yan'er is your daughter and has such potential in making talismans, I'm afraid..."
Listening to what his father said, Xu Ziyan has been meditating. After thinking about it for a long time, he still can't think of any good solution. The only thing he can think of is "procrastination.""Zijue. But I didn't know if it could be used, so I softly expressed my idea.
After listening to Xu Ziyan's words, the room was silent for a while. Finally, Xu Haoran patted his thigh and praised:
"Wonderful! We just need to arrange the eleventh brother's family in the second brother's garden, and then tell others that Yan'er doesn't like being disturbed by others, and doesn't let Lao Jiu and the others meet Haoguang. But..."
Xu Haoran suddenly fell silent again. Xu Haobo next to him also reacted and said slowly:
"It's just that when Yan'er works in Futang from now on, he has to meet people for a long time. If Lao Jiu and the others say that they must meet Yan'er's parents, I'm afraid Yan'er won't be able to refuse in person. After all, Lao Jiu and the others have such a high status in the family, and Yan'er is just a guest elder! "
"Then...I won't go to the Talisman Hall, I'll just make the Talisman in my second uncle's yard. "Xu Ziyan thought for a moment and said softly.
"This is inappropriate! Xu Haoran shook his head and said, "You are hiding in your second uncle's garden. Originally, it was nothing." Everyone knows that the Talisman Maker has a weird temper, and no one will find it strange if you don't meet others. But as the guest elder of the family, he has the right to browse the secret books below the third floor of the family library. If you don't go out to your second uncle's garden, how can you read the secrets of the library? If you don't read the tips, how can you improve your cultivation? But if you go to the library, you will inevitably meet Lao Jiu and the others. Lao Jiu and the others will not let go of the opportunity to win over you, and you cannot avoid them. "
